subtitleStreamFinding.observed: Selecting a different primary subtitle track mid-playback starts a NEW subtitle stream from the current position, so cues of the newly selected track that lie BEFORE that position are never delivered. With the clock at ~16 s, track 3's first delivered cue was index 1 (6,648-9,398 ms) and index 0 (2,148-5,148 ms) was absent; 'Previous line' therefore could not reach it and, from a position with no active cue, moved forward to the nearest later cue.
subtitleStreamFinding.workaround: Seek to 0, set the track to Off, then re-select it. Track 3 then delivered index 0 at 2,148-5,148 ms and the whole timeline was addressable.
subtitleStreamFinding.classification: directstream behaviour, not a Study OS overlay defect. Recorded so a later session does not read a missing early cue as a cue-delivery regression.
